title: The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.24 does not sanitise and escape some of its Button module settings…
description: The Live Composer WordPress plugin versions before 2.1.24 have a vulnerability where some Button module settings are not properly sanitized and escaped before being output on the front end. This flaw allows high-privilege users, such as administrators, to perform stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks even if the unfiltered_html capability is disabled, such as in multisite WordPress setups.
